errors.rule: always counted wrong: a miss if phishing, a false positive if not

speed.throughput_basis: uncached inference wall time with shared prompt KV cache
speed.latency_basis: original uncached per-email latency, after shared prompt prefill warmup

resources.gpu_memory_basis: process lifetime MLX peak; both variants ran sequentially in one process

secondary_recall_at_fpr.note: 0.1% FPR is not supported by the 1,382-negative LLM subsample; retained only as raw harness output.

qwen.scoring: P(A | A or B); A = phishing, B = legitimate; float32 log-softmax
qwen.validation_note: Frozen val_llm retained (1,382 negatives; ~14 false positives at 1%); threshold uncertainty remains.
qwen.timing_note: Measured on a busy Apple M3 with 16 GB; system memory pressure was observed late in zero-shot testing. Idle-sleep prevention was enabled near zero-shot prediction 4714 and throughout four-shot evaluation. Timings are preliminary and are not controlled hardware comparisons.
